## AntiCo-Net (≥4 taxa)

### COG

Source: `suppl/anticonet_cog_ntax4.tsv`

```{r}
df_edge_whole <- fread("suppl/anticonet_cog_ntax4.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings=c("", "NULL")) %>% as_tibble() 
df_edge_whole %>% datatable(filter = "top", escape = FALSE)
```

## Environmental distribution (GMGC)

### COG

Source: `suppl/gmgc10_cog_norm.tsv`

```{r}
df_gmgc10_cog_norm <- read.csv("suppl/gmgc10_cog_norm.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings=c("", "NULL"), row.names = NULL) %>% as_tibble()
bind_cols(
    df_gmgc10_cog_norm[,1:2],
    df_gmgc10_cog_norm[,3:16] %>% as.data.frame() %>% round(3) %>% as_tibble()
  ) %>% datatable(filter = "top")
```

### KEGG

Source: `suppl/gmgc10_kegg_norm.tsv`

```{r}
df_gmgc10_kegg_norm <- read.csv("suppl/gmgc10_kegg_norm.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings=c("", "NULL"), row.names = NULL) %>% as_tibble()
bind_cols(
    df_gmgc10_kegg_norm[,1:2],
    df_gmgc10_kegg_norm[,3:16] %>% as.data.frame() %>% round(3) %>% as_tibble()
  ) %>% datatable(filter = "top")
```

## Genome feature difference (KL divergence)

### COG

Source: `ms/gfeat_cog_kl.tsv`

```{r}
df_gfeat_cog_kl <- read.csv("ms/gfeat_cog_kl.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings=c("", "NULL"), row.names = NULL) %>% as_tibble()
df_gfeat_cog_kl_tsv <- df_gfeat_cog_kl %>% 
  mutate(KL = round(KL.divergence, 3)) %>% 
  select(Genomic.features, KL, n_tax, OG.A, Name.A, OG.B, Name.B)
colnames(df_gfeat_cog_kl_tsv) <- c("Genomic feature", "KL", "Taxa", "OG A", "Name A", "OG B", "Name B")
df_gfeat_cog_kl_tsv %>% datatable(filter = "top")
```

### KEGG

Source: `ms/gfeat_kegg_kl.tsv`

```{r}
df_gfeat_kegg_kl <- read.csv("ms/gfeat_kegg_kl.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings=c("", "NULL"), row.names = NULL) %>% as_tibble()

colnames(df_gfeat_kegg_kl_tsv) <- c("Genomic feature", "KL", "Taxa", "OG A", "Name A", "OG B", "Name B")

```
